title: Analytic: 3D PEC box cavity TM_mn0 modes (ring-down, FFT, mode profiles)
description:
A closed perfect-conductor box (2 x 1.5 x 0.6 um, 25 nm cells, pec on all six faces; em_fdtd_3d) rung by a z dipole pulse (1.7 um, bandwidth 0.4) at mid-height, off-centre so every low mode is excited; 1 ps run (~10 s).
Analytic: below c / (2 h) = 261 THz only the z-uniform TM_mn0 modes exist (E_z alone), f_mn = c/2 sqrt((m/a)^2 + (n/b)^2) with a = Lx - dx, b = Ly - dx (pec pins E_z at the centres of the outermost cells); the mid-height dipole does not excite TM_mn1. Modes 11, 21, 12, 31, 22 at 126.8, 182.7, 217.0, 249.3, 253.7 THz (fy_mn: the same on the Yee grid, ~1e-4 lower). After the pulse E_z = sum_mn C_mn psi_mn(x, y) sin(2 pi f_mn (t - t0)), psi_mn = sqrt(4/(a b h)) sin(m pi x'/a) sin(n pi y'/b) (h = Lz - dx, x', y' from the wall planes), C_mn = psi_mn(source) Il sqrt(pi) tau G(f_mn) / (2 eps0), G = exp(-((f - f0)/(bw f0))^2) the pulse spectrum.
Probes tab: em.probe vs the dashed modal sum (drawn after T_lock = 0.1 ps); its FFT vs the dashed sinc peaks |A_mn| / 2 |sin(pi (f - f_mn) T) / (pi (f - f_mn))| (T = T_run - t0).
Line profile tab: modal_x (E_z along y = y_prb) and modal_y (along x = x_prb) at the final time vs the dashed modal sum (~0.1 % of the field range; it tests the phases too).
Derived values tab: A11_lockin ... A22_lockin = the ring-down amplitudes at the probe (sin^2-windowed lock-in at fy_mn) vs A_mn (~1 %, A31_lockin ~2 %).
DFT tab: em.map_21 = |E|^2 of mode 21 at mid-height (sin^2(2 pi x'/a) sin^2(pi y'/b)).

parameters.name: dt_yee
parameters.description: time step [s] of the cubic grid

parameters.name: a_cav
parameters.description: cavity width: E_z is pinned at the centres of the outermost (pec) cells, dx/2 inside the domain

parameters.name: h_cav
parameters.description: effective height of the z-uniform modes: the nz - 1 live E_z face layers (the top grid-edge layer is pinned)

parameters.name: z_mid
parameters.description: mid-height: dipole face, probe layer, cut plane of the line curves

parameters.name: xs
parameters.description: dipole distance from the x_lo wall plane

parameters.name: ys
parameters.description: dipole distance from the y_lo wall plane

parameters.name: xp
parameters.description: probe distance from the x_lo wall plane

parameters.name: yp
parameters.description: probe distance from the y_lo wall plane

parameters.name: Il
parameters.description: peak current moment of the dipole [A m]

parameters.name: t0_pulse
parameters.description: pulse centre [s]; carrier sin(2 pi f0 (t - t0))

parameters.name: drive
parameters.description: modal drive Il sqrt(pi) tau / (2 eps0), times G(f) psi(source) psi(observer) = ring-down amplitude

parameters.name: T_run
parameters.description: study duration (lossless ring-down, 1 THz FFT resolution)

parameters.name: T_lock
parameters.description: start of the lock-in window (pulse long over)

parameters.name: T_fft
parameters.description: effective ring-down length in the probe FFT

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: final time: the tick nearest T_run

parameters.name: fy11
parameters.description: TM_110 frequency on the Yee grid [Hz]: sin(pi f dt) = c dt sqrt(sum sin^2(k_i dx/2)) / dx

parameters.name: fy32
parameters.description: TM_320 Yee frequency [Hz] (weakly excited, pulse tail)

parameters.name: fy41
parameters.description: TM_410 Yee frequency [Hz] (weakly excited, pulse tail)

parameters.name: C11
parameters.description: TM_110 modal amplitude [V/m per unit psi]: psi(source) Il sqrt(pi) tau G(f) / (2 eps0)

parameters.name: A11
parameters.description: TM_110 ring-down amplitude at the probe [V/m]

parameters.name: A21
parameters.description: TM_210 ring-down amplitude at the probe [V/m]

parameters.name: A12
parameters.description: TM_120 ring-down amplitude at the probe [V/m]

parameters.name: A31
parameters.description: TM_310 ring-down amplitude at the probe [V/m]

parameters.name: A22
parameters.description: TM_220 ring-down amplitude at the probe [V/m]

parameters.name: A32
parameters.description: TM_320 ring-down amplitude at the probe [V/m]

parameters.name: A41
parameters.description: TM_410 ring-down amplitude at the probe [V/m]

derived_values.name: A11_lockin
derived_values.expression: 4/(T_run - T_lock)*where(t > T_lock, values*sin(2*pi*fy11*(t - t0_pulse))*sin(pi*(t - T_lock)/(T_run - T_lock))**2, 0)

derived_values.name: A21_lockin
derived_values.expression: 4/(T_run - T_lock)*where(t > T_lock, values*sin(2*pi*fy21*(t - t0_pulse))*sin(pi*(t - T_lock)/(T_run - T_lock))**2, 0)

derived_values.name: A12_lockin
derived_values.expression: 4/(T_run - T_lock)*where(t > T_lock, values*sin(2*pi*fy12*(t - t0_pulse))*sin(pi*(t - T_lock)/(T_run - T_lock))**2, 0)

derived_values.name: A31_lockin
derived_values.expression: 4/(T_run - T_lock)*where(t > T_lock, values*sin(2*pi*fy31*(t - t0_pulse))*sin(pi*(t - T_lock)/(T_run - T_lock))**2, 0)

derived_values.name: A22_lockin
derived_values.expression: 4/(T_run - T_lock)*where(t > T_lock, values*sin(2*pi*fy22*(t - t0_pulse))*sin(pi*(t - T_lock)/(T_run - T_lock))**2, 0)

analytic_curves.name: modal_sum
analytic_curves.expression: where(t > T_lock, A11*sin(2*pi*fy11*(t - t0_pulse)) + A21*sin(2*pi*fy21*(t - t0_pulse)) + A12*sin(2*pi*fy12*(t - t0_pulse)) + A31*sin(2*pi*fy31*(t - t0_pulse)) + A22*sin(2*pi*fy22*(t - t0_pulse)) + A32*sin(2*pi*fy32*(t - t0_pulse)) + A41*sin(2*pi*fy41*(t - t0_pulse)), 0)

analytic_curves.name: modal_fft
analytic_curves.expression: abs(A11)/2*abs(sin(pi*(frequency - fy11)*T_fft)/(pi*(frequency - fy11))) + abs(A21)/2*abs(sin(pi*(frequency - fy21)*T_fft)/(pi*(frequency - fy21))) + abs(A12)/2*abs(sin(pi*(frequency - fy12)*T_fft)/(pi*(frequency - fy12))) + abs(A31)/2*abs(sin(pi*(frequency - fy31)*T_fft)/(pi*(frequency - fy31))) + abs(A22)/2*abs(sin(pi*(frequency - fy22)*T_fft)/(pi*(frequency - fy22))) + abs(A32)/2*abs(sin(pi*(frequency - fy32)*T_fft)/(pi*(frequency - fy32))) + abs(A41)/2*abs(sin(pi*(frequency - fy41)*T_fft)/(pi*(frequency - fy41)))

analytic_curves.name: modal_x
analytic_curves.expression: Q11*sin(pi*(x - dx_cell/2)/a_cav)*sin(pi*yp/b_cav) + Q21*sin(2*pi*(x - dx_cell/2)/a_cav)*sin(pi*yp/b_cav) + Q12*sin(pi*(x - dx_cell/2)/a_cav)*sin(2*pi*yp/b_cav) + Q31*sin(3*pi*(x - dx_cell/2)/a_cav)*sin(pi*yp/b_cav) + Q22*sin(2*pi*(x - dx_cell/2)/a_cav)*sin(2*pi*yp/b_cav) + Q32*sin(3*pi*(x - dx_cell/2)/a_cav)*sin(2*pi*yp/b_cav) + Q41*sin(4*pi*(x - dx_cell/2)/a_cav)*sin(pi*yp/b_cav)

analytic_curves.name: modal_y
analytic_curves.expression: Q11*sin(pi*xp/a_cav)*sin(pi*(y - dx_cell/2)/b_cav) + Q21*sin(2*pi*xp/a_cav)*sin(pi*(y - dx_cell/2)/b_cav) + Q12*sin(pi*xp/a_cav)*sin(2*pi*(y - dx_cell/2)/b_cav) + Q31*sin(3*pi*xp/a_cav)*sin(pi*(y - dx_cell/2)/b_cav) + Q22*sin(2*pi*xp/a_cav)*sin(2*pi*(y - dx_cell/2)/b_cav) + Q32*sin(3*pi*xp/a_cav)*sin(2*pi*(y - dx_cell/2)/b_cav) + Q41*sin(4*pi*xp/a_cav)*sin(pi*(y - dx_cell/2)/b_cav)
